=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:169-267 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: safe_rel_path() keeps a path only if it already resolves to an existing regular file (`resolve(strict=True)` + `is_file()`). Paths that the trusted --plan-file says will be created are therefore dropped before they reach open_prs() overlap matching.
  WHY: When a plan lists new files under "Files likely to change", open PRs touching those same new paths are left out of the evidence pack, so the collision that P4 is meant to surface goes unreported. Severity disagreement: four reviewers rated it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT as a contract-quality note.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:278-293 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Builder.gh() calls `gh_api_retry.call(args, idempotent=idempotent, optional=True)` without `max_attempts`, so each logical call can make up to 5 attempts (scripts/gh_api_retry.py:405).
  WHY: The four logical calls can grow to as many as 20 HTTP requests, against the documented budget of 4 calls per build. Rate-limit sleeps of up to 600 s each can also stall the clarify and implement steps. Severity disagreement: three reviewers rated it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 downgraded it to a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:278-293 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `import gh_api_retry` fails, the except branch prints a full `PERSIST evidence_pack outcome=partial calls=0 bytes=0 reason=gh_api_retry_unavailable` line on every call (up to 4), never sets self.partial, and falls back to a raw `gh api` subprocess with no breaker.
  WHY: This breaks the one-line-per-build PERSIST log contract: the final line can read `outcome=ok calls=4` after the earlier partial lines. It also bypasses the rate-limit breaker that the agents fragment promises.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:278-293 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `subprocess.run(["gh", "api", ...])` inherits the full token environment but drops the optional semantics, breaker checks, `-i` header handling, `--paginate` and classification.
  WHY: If the gh_api_retry import fails, the build still makes up to 4 untracked raw `gh api` calls per build. This quietly widens the capability surface, contrary to "honours the rate-limit breaker"; the reviewer says the fallback should be a logged skip.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:303-496 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When the PR API response fails or is malformed, open_prs() returns None and render() emits an `(unavailable)` section. cmd_build() then writes a partial pack instead of the `(evidence unavailable: <reason>)` stub.
  WHY: The prompt gets a partial pack, and consumers keyed on the stub token cannot tell that the build failed. The reviewers cite docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:264, 427-430 and the agents fragment. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this, quoting agents.d/8427-p4-persist-evidence-pack.md ("an unavailable section reads `(unavailable)`").
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:650-678 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The P4 staging loop stages only evidence_pack.py. The helper's module-level import of targeted_file_context works only because the P2 acceptance_check loop happens to stage that file, and the coupling is undocumented.
  WHY: If the P2 loop changes or the support ref lacks targeted_file_context.py, every plan build writes `(evidence unavailable: helper_absent)`. It fails open, but silently, and no guard test catches it.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:File-level (CI failure: static-checks) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script is expected to include `watchdog_helpers.sh` but does not.
  WHY: The reviewer says static-checks fails with `watchdog-shared-helper` | `required-helper-missing`. Disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it because the guard list at .github/workflows/ci.yml:188-192 covers only implement.yml, review_apply_fixes.sh and validate_process.sh.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The P4 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass" and "Pair workflow/script changes with the contract tests the plan calls for" (issue #8518); the plan lists the new tests/test_evidence_pack.py
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, one line `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_evidence_pack.py` next to the P1/P2 wiring at ci.yml:669-670 (Pre-push affected-test gate tests step)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk in .github/workflows/ci.yml or any other workflow names tests/test_evidence_pack.py. PR head 671f43e fails static-checks at `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py::test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow`, listing tests/test_evidence_pack.py as unwired (UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST is empty at line 25). ci.yml is not in the ai:pipeline-plan-grant files_touched list, so the grant conflict must be surfaced explicitly rather than scope being widened silently. Severity BLOCKER from all reviewers.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:safe_rel_path(), the line `resolved = candidate.resolve(strict=True)` followed by `if not resolved.is_file(): return None`, used by collect_paths() for the trusted --plan-file branch | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Paths from the trusted approved plan are dropped unless they already exist as regular files, so files the plan creates never reach open_prs().
  WHY: In the implement "Build evidence pack" step (`--plan-file "${PLAN_FILE}"`), OPEN PULL REQUESTS shows "(no paths to match)" or "(none)" even when a trusted PR touches the same new path. The reviewer proposes applying only the syntactic checks for the trusted plan file.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:Builder.gh() except branch (`gh_api_retry = None; print("PERSIST evidence_pack outcome=partial calls=0 bytes=0 reason=gh_api_retry_unavailable"...)` then raw `subprocess.run(["gh", "api", *args], ...)` fallback) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the import fails, a PERSIST line is printed on every call, self.partial is never set, and calls fall back to raw gh with no breaker; the final line can read `outcome=ok calls=4`.
  WHY: This contradicts the one-line-per-build contract and bypasses the breaker; it is reachable only when gh_api_retry.py is not staged, and all callers stage it.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "Pair workflow/script changes with the contract tests the plan calls for" and "The P4 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass" (issue #8518).
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, pytest step for tests/test_evidence_pack.py next to ci.yml:669-670.
  Evidence of absence: No workflow names the test; static-checks on 671f43e fails test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow. ci.yml is not in the files_touched grant, and the editor must surface this conflict.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING (3 related items): pass `max_attempts=2` (or 1) to gh_api_retry.call in Builder.gh(); add `timeout-minutes: 5` to the "Build evidence pack" steps in clarify.yml and implement.yml; in the Builder.gh() except branch, set self.partial = True, drop the per-call print, and return None. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- NOTE (4 rejected or downgraded ledger items): the run_plan_codex.sh watchdog claim is rejected; the `(evidence unavailable: <reason>)` stub claim is rejected because `(unavailable)` matches the agents.d contract; the max_attempts budget claim is downgraded to hardening; the 14 other pre-push failures are not caused by this PR.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
